name: alertmanager
title: Alertmanager
description: Alertmanager takes the alerts Prometheus raises, groups and silences them, and sends them on to Discord, e-mail, a webhook and more. It deploys with a receiver that sends nothing: add yours in App-Data/Alertmanager/config/alertmanager.yml and restart, then name this Alertmanager under alerting in prometheus.yml (targets: ['Alertmanager:9093']).
